text:
incident-bot: ALERT: eval-gate triggered for workspace 'prod' on model 'redwood-3b-qa' (v2026-02-18). Failure mode: safety/regression + output-drift on prompt set 'financial-advice-helpcenter'. PagerDuty incident PD-83421 created and paged on-call. See summary: safety hits up 14% vs baseline, hallucination rate +9% on monitored prompts.

pagerduty-bot: PD-83421 — Trigger: EvalGate::safety_threshold. Severity: high. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-83421

maria_gonzalez: Acked on PD. I'm on it — pulling eval logs and recent deploys now. @sam_irwin can you check rollout history? Any auto-rollouts happened in the last 12h?

sam_irwin: Looking — I see a canary rollout at 02:11 UTC that switched 5% traffic to v2026-02-18 (the flagged build). Canary autoscale + model cache bump at 02:09. No other config changes.

jen_lee: Heads-up: customer #AcmePayments reported odd risk flags from our model in a production flow ~03:15 UTC. They're in Dedicated region-us-west-2. Could be correlated.

maria_gonzalez: Noted. Running quick regression to compare outputs. If noise is high we should fallback to previous pinned version for Dedicated customers while we investigate.

kevins: I can run a targeted rollback on the dedicated pool for AcmePayments (pool id: dp-aws-usw2-acme). Recommend pinning to v2026-01-30. Want me to proceed?

maria_gonzalez: Do it. Add a short traffic-swap (5m) and monitor safety metric. Use the immediate rollback API: 

kevins: Executing now:

```
# pin model version for dedicated pool
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/dedicated/pools/dp-aws-usw2-acme/pin
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDCONN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","version":"v2026-01-30","reason":"eval-gate safety regression, PD-83421"}'
```

kevins: Pin request accepted. Pool scale unchanged. Monitoring safety hits for that pool.

maria_gonzalez: Good. I'm gating inbound evals and re-running the failing prompt set across the last 24h traffic logs to see when the regression spike started.

sam_irwin: I checked the model artifact repo: the v2026-02-18 build included a tokenizer update and a minor quantization tweak. Could be affecting generation truncation/beam scoring and safety classifier signals.

jen_lee: If tokenizer changed tokenization boundaries for finance phrases, that could explain new hallucinations. We should run the tokenizer-diffs on impacted prompts. Maria — can you fetch sample pairs?

maria_gonzalez: Pulling 500 recent failing outputs now, focusing on prompts that triggered safety flags and user-reported examples from Acme. ETA ~6 min.

incident-bot: NOTE: Auto-escalation scheduled in 10m if no full ack/resolution.

sam_irwin: Also checking rollout policy: auto-fallback isn't configured for safety-gate trips in Dedicated yet (we rely on manual pinning). Should we open an action item to add automated immediate fallback for safety eval gate trips? Not now, but logging it.

jen_lee: Agree — follow-up. Right now we need live mitigation. Maria, if pin shows improvement, let's keep pinned and then coordinate a hotfix revert in model onboarding pipeline.

maria_gonzalez: Initial diffs: safety hit rate on the pinned pool dropped from 18% -> 4% after pin. That's promising. But global hosted API still shows elevated rate (8% baseline 2%). Seems the canary still exposing some traffic.

kevins: I can force global canary back down to 0% for v2026-02-18. Rolling back canary routing now.

kevins: Routing update complete — canary traffic removed. Confirming telemetry...

maria_gonzalez: Telemetry shows global safety hits trending down after routing change. Host metrics now 3.1% (was 8.2%). Acme dedicated at 3.9%.

jen_lee: Good containment. Next: root cause blamestick — tokenizer change + quantization tweak. Sam, can you coordinate a quick AB test: v2026-02-18 with tokenizer reverted but keeping other changes? We need to isolate.

sam_irwin: On it. Spinning a variant (v2026-02-18a) with previous tokenizer. Will run eval suite against failing prompt set.

maria_gonzalez: Customer comms — @oncall-rotation please notify AcmePayments support contact that we identified a model regression, contained it by reverting dedicated routing, and we are doing deeper analysis. Use incident template: short summary, what we changed, next steps.

oncall-rotation: Notifying now. Message: "We detected a regression in model responses for certain financial help prompts and have reverted the model for your dedicated pool. We're running an analysis and will share findings by EOD. Please let us know if you continue to see issues." Sent to AcmeContacts#ops.

pagerduty-bot: PD-83421 status: acknowledged by maria_gonzalez at 2790012352. Assigned to: maria_gonzalez, sam_irwin.

maria_gonzalez: Quick triage notes:
- Impacted customers: small subset (Dedicated pools + a fraction of hosted canary). One customer reported false risk alerts (AcmePayments).
- Severity: High (potential financial risk signals; human review required).
- Mitigation: Pinned Dedicated pool for Acme to v2026-01-30, removed global canary traffic for v2026-02-18.
- Current status: containment successful, telemetry improving.
- Next steps: run tokenizer diff AB, prepare hotfix, coordinate rollback of quantization tweak if needed, postmortem.

kevins: Also enabling extra sampling of user-visible outputs (add more logs for the flagged prompts) for 1h so ML team can annotate and build a fine-grained eval set.

sam_irwin: AB results preliminary: reverting tokenizer reduces hallucination signals by ~60% on failing prompts. Quantization change seems secondary but amplifies classifier sensitivity. Looks like combined effect.

maria_gonzalez: Plan: block release promotion for v2026-02-18. Create release-rollback PR and run full regression tests. Sam/Jen/Kevins to own hotfix. I'll keep PD updated.

incident-bot: REMINDER: Please add the incident to the tracking board and assign a postmortem owner within 48h.

jen_lee: I'll take the postmortem owner role. Will coordinate with ML research for root cause write-up and remediation plan (tokenizer gating + stricter eval-gate for quant changes).

maria_gonzalez: PD final note for now: containment achieved, on-call continues monitoring for next 2h. If any new safety alarms, re-page. Closing slack thread once monitoring window passes.

sam_irwin: Adding checklist items to the incident ticket: rollback PR, add tokenizer-diff integration tests, extend eval-gate coverage for finance prompt sets, automation for immediate fallback on safety trips.

jen_lee: Thanks everyone. Great quick response. :clap:

maria_gonzalez: I'll update PD and then archive this thread.

pagerduty-bot: PD-83421 — status updated: resolved (containment) at 2790012478.

incident-bot: Thread closed by maria_gonzalez. Monitoring window open until 2790013280.

maria_gonzalez: (postscript) Action items captured: 1) automated fallback for safety trips 2) tokenizer diff test 3) extend eval-gate thresholds for quant changes 4) customer follow-up with Acme. I'll create tickets now.
